situation: The client's operating margin declined from 20% to 11% over 3 years.
reason_to_start_there: Margin fell 9 points; COGS is usually the largest cost line, so it most likely explains a drop this size
specific_request_examples: COGS as a share of revenue by year for the last 3 years; price per unit by product line
vague_request_examples: Information about costs; data on the market
model_answer: I'd break the margin into price, volume mix and costs. I'd start with COGS as a share of revenue over the 3 years, since it's the biggest cost line, then check operating expenses and average price by product line.
